Note.title: Note
Note.description: A notebook entry belonging to an authenticated user, including institute context, course metadata, content, and timestamps.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this note.

title.description: The title of the note (1 to 200 characters).

content.description: The full text body of the note (0 to 20000 characters).

subject.description: The academic category or subject of the note (1 to 80 characters).

courseCode.description: Optional course code or unit identifier (0 to 40 characters).

instituteName.description: Name of the academic institute associated with this note (1 to 120 characters).

colorIndex.description: Visual card theme index from 0 to 5.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top of the notebook.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was created. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the note was last modified. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

InstituteProfile.title: InstituteProfile
InstituteProfile.description: Academic institute header details configured by the user for their notebook and PDF exports.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

instituteName.description: The name of the educational institute or university (1 to 120 characters).

department.description: Department or faculty name (1 to 100 characters).

academicSession.description: Current semester or academic year (1 to 60 characters).

studentOrFacultyName.description: Name of the notebook owner (1 to 100 characters).

rollOrIdNumber.description: Optional student roll number or faculty ID (0 to 60 characters).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: Stores individual notebook entries scoped under each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/profile/{profileId}.description: Stores the user's institute profile metadata for home screen header and PDF headers.
